columns.title: Drafts list (US-249, US-248)
columns.line: «Dosare inițiate din oficiu»: the user's own ex-officio drafts, search, filters, export, removal and the no-rights state.

columns.title: Act search (US-242)
columns.line: „Nou” opens the act search; an act's menu offers the configured post-processes; confirming one creates the draft.

columns.title: Holder data (US-243)
columns.line: The holder comes from the act (read-only); contacts are prefilled from the act and can be corrected.

columns.title: Service details and decision (US-244)
columns.line: Act data prefilled, the post-process fields, the authority's decision as an electronic form or a PDF, the processing subdivision.

columns.title: Required documents (US-20)
columns.line: The documents the ex-officio post-process needs, with the same upload cards as the desk.

columns.title: Review (US-245)
columns.line: Four review sections with the decision card first and a permanent hint; incomplete steps send the user back.

columns.title: Delivery (US-16)
columns.line: How the holder receives the result: electronically in EVO Cabinet or on paper; no MDelivery.

columns.title: Submission (US-246)
columns.line: Confirmation without MSign or payment note, the submitted dossier, the error, and where the dossier appears next.

columns.title: Drafts: resume, save, remove (US-247, US-248)
columns.line: A draft reopens at its last step; save, header menu, change the act or post-process, remove, history.

columns.title: No rights on step links (US-243…248 AC-01)
columns.line: A role without the permission opening any step or draft link directly sees the no-rights dialog.

columns.title: Removal warning (US-247 AC-09)
columns.line: The bell warns before the automatic removal; the notification opens the draft.

columns.title: Audit journal
columns.line: Every step of the flow is logged; „Istoricul cererii” shows the journal.

ofc-01: Only the user's own ex-officio drafts: number with the post-process, service, holder, company, dates and the automatic removal date. „Nou” starts a new dossier.
ofc-01a: A search by number, holder or company that matches nothing shows the filtered empty state.
ofc-01b: Empty list: „Nu sunt schițe înregistrate.” with the „Nou” button.
ofc-01c: „Filtrare” shows the facets: service, creation date, last change and automatic removal date.
ofc-01d: The export button opens the CSV export dialog for the current list.
ofc-01e: After the export the success toast confirms the file.
ofc-01f: The grey trash asks „Sigur doriți să eliminați schița dosarului?”. No reason is needed; the red button removes it.
ofc-01g: The draft leaves the list and a toast confirms the removal.
ofc-01h: A role without the permission opens the item and sees the shared no-rights state.
ofc-01i: The central administrator has the permission by default and sees the same list.
ofc-02:
The window opens on the act search: service select and one live search over act number, IDNP and IDNO. Acts without a configured post-process have no menu.
Search by name, object and service: not in US-242 — PO to confirm.
ofc-02a:
Typing an IDNO narrows the list to that company's acts as you type.
Search by name, object and service: not in US-242 — PO to confirm.
ofc-02c: Choosing a service in „Denumirea serviciului” keeps only that service's acts.
ofc-02b: No match shows „Nu există acte permisive care să corespundă căutării.”.
ofc-02d: The act's menu lists only the ex-officio types configured for the act's status; Retragere is red and last.
ofc-02e: A suspended act offers only „Reluare valabilitate”.
ofc-02g:
An act with a dossier in progress has no menu button and shows the warning with the dossier number.
Locked-act warning: not in US-242 — PO to confirm.
ofc-02f: A user with desk permission only opens the link and sees the no-rights state.
ofc-03: The holder comes from the act and is read-only. Phone and e-mail are prefilled from the act and can be corrected.
ofc-03a: A short phone number and a .ru address show their errors under the fields after „Înainte”.
ofc-03b: The phone is required; an e-mail without a domain shows the format error.
ofc-04:
Act data prefilled read-only, the post-process fields and „Decizia autorității” as an electronic form. „Procesat de subdiviziunea” is read-only, without a required star.
Decision fields and the 60 MB PDF limit: not in US-244 — PO to confirm.
„Valabil până la (termenul nou)”: not named in US-244 — PO to confirm.
ofc-04f:
Suspension asks for the end date and the reason before the decision.
Decision fields and the 60 MB PDF limit: not in US-244 — PO to confirm.
Suspendare „până la” date: not named in US-244 — PO to confirm.
ofc-04a:
„Înainte” with empty fields marks every required field with its error.
Decision fields and the 60 MB PDF limit: not in US-244 — PO to confirm.
ofc-04e:
A date that breaks the rule shows its message under the field.
Decision fields and the 60 MB PDF limit: not in US-244 — PO to confirm.
ofc-04b:
„Fișier PDF” replaces the content field with the boxed upload.
Decision fields and the 60 MB PDF limit: not in US-244 — PO to confirm.
ofc-04c:
The signed decision PDF appears as a document card in the box.
Decision fields and the 60 MB PDF limit: not in US-244 — PO to confirm.
ofc-04d:
A non-PDF file is rejected with the error under the box.
Decision fields and the 60 MB PDF limit: not in US-244 — PO to confirm.
ofc-05: The documents configured for the ex-officio post-process, with the desk's upload cards.
ofc-05a: „Înainte” with a required document missing shows the error on its card.
ofc-06: Four sections: general data, holder, request and attachments. „Atașamente” lists the predefined documents with «Atașat» Da / Nu, then the decision. The hint says corrections are made from the stepper.
ofc-06a: The electronic decision opens in the MDocs print preview.
ofc-06b: Going to the confirmation with „Detalii serviciu” incomplete shows the toast and returns to that step.
ofc-07: The holder receives the result electronically in EVO Cabinet by default. No MDelivery: it would need a payment note.
ofc-07a: Choosing paper shows where the holder collects the document.
ofc-08: Readiness list: data validated, no MSign signature and no payment note needed. „Confirmă depunerea” submits.
ofc-08a:
Success hero and the details card: number, date, term in working days, status „În procesare · Proiect act”, post-process, channel, responsible.
Responsabil, „Deschide dosarul”, toast: not in US-246 — PO to confirm.
ofc-08b: A failed submission keeps the data and offers „Reîncercați”.
ofc-08c:
„Înapoi la Dosare inițiate din oficiu” closes the window; the submitted draft is gone and a toast confirms it.
Close toast: not in US-246 — PO to confirm.
ofc-08d: The dossier joins the initiator's „Dosarele mele” with the origin „Din oficiu”.
ofc-08e:
„Deschide dosarul” opens the BO profile: trajectory starts with „Inițiat · Din oficiu”.
„Deschide dosarul”: not in US-246 — PO to confirm.
ofc-08f:
In a new act search the act now shows the dossier in progress and has no menu button.
Locked-act warning: not in US-242 — PO to confirm.
ofc-09: Opening a draft from the list continues at its last step.
ofc-09a: „Salvează schița” validates, saves and the toast confirms; the header shows the save time.
ofc-09b: The header menu: „Schimbă actul sau postprocesul”, history and the red „Elimină schița”.
ofc-09c:
The confirmation warns that the details, decision and documents are lost; the red button returns to the act search.
„Schimbă actul” confirmation: not in US-247 — PO to confirm.
ofc-09d: The same removal confirmation as in the list, opened from the header menu.
ofc-09e:
A link to a removed draft shows who removed it and when, with „Dosar nou din oficiu”.
Removed-draft page: not in US-248 — PO to confirm.
ofc-09f:
The history dialog lists the draft's saves and changes. The subtitle shows no request number.
History dialog: not in US-247 — PO to confirm.
ofc-01j: „Anulează” in the removal confirmation closes it; the draft stays in the list unchanged.
ofc-01k: Columns sort on click; the default is „Data ultimei modificări”, newest first. Here the list is sorted by „Data eliminării automate”.
ofc-02k: After closing the window the new draft is listed in «Dosare inițiate din oficiu».
ofc-02l: The act search lists only acts issued by the user's authority. An ANTA specialist sees none of ANSP's acts.
ofc-06c: After a correction in „Date titular” the user returns to „Verificare” from the stepper; the summary shows the new e-mail.
ofc-06d: „Atașamente” lists the predefined documents with «Atașat» Da or Nu. A missing required one is red and the warning names it.
ofc-08g: While the dossier is not fully valid, „Confirmă depunerea” is disabled.
ofc-08h: The submitted dossier is also listed in „Dosarele mele” › „Toate”.
ofc-09g:
Past the retention period SIA GEAP removes the draft. Opening it shows the date and the reason; access is off and „Dosar nou din oficiu” starts again.
Removed-draft page: not in US-248 — PO to confirm.
ofc-09h:
„Salvează schița” with invalid fields shows every error at once. Nothing is saved and there is no toast.
Closing with invalid data does not save either: not in US-247 — PO to confirm.
ofc-10a: No rights on a step link

A role without the permission opening a step or draft link sees the no-rights dialog. States 10a–10e (Date titular, Detalii serviciu, Verificare, Confirmare, a draft) are identical, so this block shows all five.
ofc-11:
Before the automatic removal the bell shows an internal notification with the exact date; the same warning goes out by MNotify.
Bell dropdown: not in US-247 — PO to confirm.
ofc-11a: The notification opens the draft at its last step so the user can finish it.
ofc-12: „Istoricul cererii” shows the audit journal: first save, contact change, step entries and saves, each with date, user and the person concerned.
ofc-02h: The act's ⋮ menu › a post-process opens the „Before you start” dialog: what it does, the term, no fee. „Începe” creates the draft and opens „Date titular”; „Anulează” saves nothing.
ofc-02h2: A consequential post-process (Suspendare, Retragere, Anulare) shows its consequence as a warning or error notice and a red „Începe”. Same next steps as OFC-02H.
ofc-02i: „Anulează” (or ×, Esc) closes the „Before you start” dialog; the act search stays as it was and no draft is created.
ofc-02j: „Începe” in the „Before you start” dialog creates the draft: the number, «Schiță» and the save time appear in the header and „Date titular” opens.
